works.title: The Great Deleveraging
works.description: A two-part essay analyzing the economic mechanics of a 10% credit-card rate cap and proposing a demand-side rescue plan (Postal Bank/Fairness Dividend). Part I examines the credit crunch cascade triggered by Trump's cap; Part II outlines the systemic recovery through direct demand injection. Includes satirical cartoons, headlines, Midjourney images, and political outreach strategy targeting sympathetic senators.
works.quote: The Great Deleveraging: How the 10% Cap Breaks the Banks—and How the Postal Bank and Fairness Dividend Save America

works.title: The Supreme Chumps
works.description: A satirical political novel chronicling Trump-era Supreme Court justices (particularly Chief Justice Roberts and the right-wing bloc) through fictional backroom deliberations. The narrative deliberately roots itself in historical fact before projecting into the future, framing judicial corruption and betrayal of democratic principles through a moral lens distinguishing between right and wrong. Includes braided narrative structure debate and character development for Alito and Thomas.
works.quote: To create a powerful fictional narrative that permanently stains the legacy of the Trump-era Supreme Court by dramatizing judicial corruption and betrayal through satirical backroom deliberations
